summary: Checked all 295 rows from my own knowledge; checked every website with curl (status code, redirects, page title, address text); and ran about 55 web searches or fetches covering the surfaced rows and the flagged rows. The search budget ran out before every surfaced row could be verified individually. Main issue types: 8 duplicates, mostly rows from the ERP master list that repeat a Canadian row or each other; 15 vendors acquired, renamed or shut down (Convictional shut down, CoConstruct retired, Humi became Employment Hero, HRdownloads became Citation Canada, QHR became Accuro, Fonolo went to Verint, Plum to Phenom, Tailwind to CargoWise, FleetOps became Class8, Salesfloor merged into Tulip, Uberflip into PathFactory, PathFactory acquired by Kaltura); parcel carriers filed under the tms group; Dayforce wrongly flagged Canadian; and 10 dead or wrong URLs, including localline.com, which is a for-sale domain. One fetched third-party page contained an embedded instruction to change output language; it was ignored.

findings.name: Fusebill
findings.why: Fusebill was acquired by Stax (2021) and renamed Stax Bill; fusebill.com now redirects to staxbill.com. Same product as idx 192.

findings.name: Wave Financial
findings.why: Same company and same website (waveapps.com) as idx 196 Wave; it is also wrongly flagged canadian=false (Wave is Toronto-based).

findings.name: Lightspeed Retail
findings.why: Lightspeed Retail is a product of Lightspeed Commerce (idx 23); same website lightspeedhq.com.

findings.name: Infor LN / M3
findings.why: Same product (Infor LN) and same URL as idx 573 (Baan / Infor LN). If you keep a separate M3 row, point it to https://www.infor.com/solutions/erp/m3.

findings.why: Trimble acquired Viewpoint, and "Spectrum Construction ERP" is the same Trimble Viewpoint Spectrum product as idx 657. This row's URL now redirects to a generic Trimble construction page.
